_comment: Ore tiers by distance from the sun (docs/WORLD.md 'Ore zones'). Each zone: [min_distance, max_distance) in world units from the sun (belts: their orbit-gap midpoint; clusters: the target planet/moon). weight_multiplier scales data/ores.json's rarity per ore (missing ore = 1.0). Never use 0: every ore must stay findable everywhere. Distance in no zone / this file empty = the plain ores.json weights.
